parsed_json.up: Select activity details for CHEMBL122 (ROFECOXIB) and all its salts against target CHEMBL230 (Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2) where the standard_type is IC50 and standard_units is nM. Use molecule_hierarchy to define the compound set from the parent CHEMBL122, then retrieve activity provenance through the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include canonical_smiles via LEFT JOIN compound_structures. Return the exact columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
